items.duration: Typically within 2 years (2/2/2/2); 2/3/3 schedule ≈1.5 years; marketing also cites as little as 16 months. AI/ML track launches Fall 2027.
items.credits: Eight graduate-level graded courses (avg ≥B). Basic: 6 courses; Advanced: 2× 2000-level electives or 2× CSCI 2980 project.
items.coreNotes: No single fixed core list — flexible electives under Master’s Contract with advisor/DGS approval. At least 3 of Basic Component must be CSCI.
items.academic: Brown CS ScM: 8 graded graduate courses within ~2 years (or ~1.5–16 months accelerated). Comprehensive or AI/ML tracks; optional professional internships and CSCI 2980 research project.

items.duration: Full-time registration for three semesters required.
items.credits: 30 graduate credits. Course-only: ≥18 CS + ≥6 outside CS + ≥6 electives; ≥6 credits must be project-heavy (≥30% weight). Project/thesis: ≥12 CS + 6 outside + 6 electives + ≤6 ungraded research. CS 704 required.
items.coreNotes: No universal named core set beyond concentration menus (AI/ML and Cybersecurity). Master’s exam required (portfolio oral or project/thesis defense).
items.academic: Duke CS MS: 30 credits over three full-time semesters. Course-only, project, or thesis; optional AI/ML or Cybersecurity concentrations; master’s exam required.

items.duration: Average time to degree ~3 semesters (department page).
items.credits: 8 approved ≥3-credit courses + faculty-guided research project/essay/thesis, OR 10 approved courses. Breadth: ≥1 course from at least 4 of 5 core areas (Application, Reasoning, Software, Systems, Theory).
items.coreNotes: Core areas: Application, Reasoning, Software, Systems, Theory — take from ≥4 of 5. AI track and HLT concentration have additional menus.
items.academic: JHU CS MSE: 10 courses or 8 + research; ~3 semesters typical. Breadth across ≥4 of 5 areas; optional AI track and HLT concentration.

items.duration: Can finish in 3–4 quarters; most take 4; thesis/project/internship may extend.
items.credits: 12 graduate letter-graded units; ≥6 COMP_SCI; ≥3 units at 400-level+; overall GPA ≥3.0.
items.coreNotes: Flexible plan of study with MS director — no fixed named core list on marketing page; see 2025–26 MS manual for detail.
items.academic: Northwestern CS MS: 12 graduate units, typically 3–4 quarters. Default course-only (Plan C); optional thesis (A) or project (B).

items.duration: Full-time often ~2 years at ~9 credits/semester; GSAS maximum five years. Do not invent a shorter guaranteed path.
items.credits: Standard MSCS 30 credits: three foundations (Fundamental Algorithms, Programming Languages, Operating Systems) + application area + capstone (B+). 36-credit option adds AI or Systems/Security concentration.
items.coreNotes: Foundations: Fundamental Algorithms, Programming Languages, Operating Systems; plus application area and capstone.
items.academic: NYU Courant MSCS: 30-credit standard with three foundations + application + capstone, or 36-credit AI / Systems-Security concentrations. Full-time typically ~2 years; max 5 years.
items.orientation: 30 or 36 credits · Foundations + capstone · ~2 years FT

items.credits: 30 graduate credit hours; non-thesis. Includes cores, one specialization, COMP 608 Workplace Communication, electives, and a 3–6 month internship.
tracks: Specializations: AI; Bioinformatics/Computational Biology; Data Science & ML; Management & Leadership; Systems & Security
items.coreNotes: Specialization menus on Rice MCS pages — cite specialization pages rather than inventing course titles.
items.academic: Rice MCS: 30-credit non-thesis professional master’s, normally 3 semesters, with specialization + internship + COMP 608.

items.duration: One-year MS: two terms (4 courses/term for visa full-time). Two-year MS: thesis + teaching across four terms. Non-visa may part-time up to four years on one-year track.
items.credits: One-year: 8 approved courses (optional CPSC 692 independent project may count). Two-year: 6 approved courses + research thesis + 20 hr/week TF each term.
items.coreNotes: Courses from an approved list — do not invent a fixed core set. Grade rules: avg High Pass with ≥1 Honors (handbook).
items.academic: Yale CS terminal MS: one-year (8 courses) or selective two-year (6 courses + thesis + teaching). Visa students on one-year track take 4 degree courses per term.

items.duration: Full-time typically 1.5–2 years; part-time longer (online marketing). Exact residency not fixed here — do not invent.
items.credits: General MS CS: 32 units (CSCI 570 + 28 electives). Thesis option adds units (36 for Fall 2024+ entrants per department pages). Many named specializations also ~32 units.
tracks: Named specializations (e.g. Data Science and others on Viterbi site)
items.coreNotes: General track lists CSCI 570 as required; specialization cores vary — cite each specialization page.
items.academic: USC Viterbi MS CS (General): 32 units with CSCI 570 + electives; thesis and many specializations available; FT often 1.5–2 years.
